publicationRequirements: product version and immutable content hash
source publisher, licence and source/capture date
horizontal CRS and coordinate epoch where applicable
vertical CRS or datum, including the geoid model where applicable
terrain model (bare earth or surface) and processing method
interpolation or derivation method and parameters

products.label: Bare-earth elevation
products.measurement: Elevation of the terrain surface after buildings and vegetation are removed.

availability.reason: No versioned terrain source has been ingested and validated for this product yet.

notes: This is a digital terrain model (DTM), not surface elevation.
Point values will declare their interpolation method.

products.label: Surface elevation
products.measurement: Elevation of the first-return surface, including buildings and vegetation where the source represents them.

availability.reason: No versioned terrain source has been ingested and validated for this product yet.

notes: This is a digital surface model (DSM) and must never be substituted for bare-earth elevation.

products.label: Terrain slope
products.measurement: Maximum local rate of terrain elevation change.

availability.reason: No versioned terrain source has been ingested and validated for this product yet.

notes: The derivative algorithm and neighbourhood must be published.

products.label: Terrain aspect
products.measurement: Direction of steepest terrain descent, clockwise from true north.

availability.reason: No versioned terrain source has been ingested and validated for this product yet.

notes: The convention for flat cells must be published.

products.label: Terrain contours

availability.reason: No versioned terrain source has been ingested and validated for this product yet.

notes: The contour interval, index-contour rule and generalisation must be published.

products.label: Terrain hillshade
products.measurement: A rendered terrain-relief product for visual context, not a measurement layer.

availability.reason: No versioned terrain source has been ingested and validated for this product yet.

notes: The illumination azimuth, altitude, z-factor and rendering method must be published.
